tools.name: find_dealers
tools.description: List franchise car dealers in Utah, optionally by county market (e.g. "salt-lake-county" or "Davis County"), make (e.g. "Toyota"), city (e.g. "Murray") and service option (saturday-service, sunday-service, collision-center, buy-online, express-service, loaner-cars, spanish-speaking). Ordered by coun

tools.name: dealer_facts
tools.description: Every fact on record for one dealer (by slug from find_dealers, or by name): its Everroad Score (0 to 100) with the category breakdown and a link to every metric, hours by department, weekend service, posted doc fee, service options, with the source URL and checked date of each fact.

tools.name: dealer_score
tools.description: One dealer's Everroad Score (0 to 100): the number, band and formula version, each category's points, measured-weight coverage (how much of the score rests on the store's own data), every measured metric with its source, and the metrics the dealer controls through its own website that are not on rec

tools.name: compare_dealers
tools.description: Facts for 2 to 5 dealers side by side, in the order given: hours, weekend sales and service, posted doc fee, service and buying options, and each Everroad Score with its basis. A fact one dealer has not stated shows as not stated. It lines the facts up; it names no winner.

tools.name: weekend_hours
tools.description: Saturday and Sunday sales and service hours for every dealer with readable hours, optionally in one county market (e.g. "utah-county") or city, plus the totals. Utah dealers may not sell on both Saturday and Sunday.

tools.name: fee_law
tools.description: What Utah law says about the dealer documentary (doc) fee and the Saturday/Sunday selling rule, with the explainer page URLs and the date the sources were checked.

tools.name: report
tools.description: The numbers of a published report, with coverage and method link. Slug: utah-weekend-dealer-access (the Weekend Access Report).
